name: a-per-frame-reel-alt-is-reported
breaks: a model that wrote one alt per photograph for a post type asking for one alt about the whole post is trimmed silently again, so what ships is a single frame's description: correctly formed, true of one picture, and indistinguishable from a compliant reel level alt. It fails a bit over half the time on the Thursday reels in the live store, and the detection is thrown away at the moment it is made (#1067, L340)
